definition.title: Take a weekly traffic snapshot
definition.description: Each week, read Search Console and PostHog into one data file per landing page: clicks, impressions and top searches, sessions by channel, first-touch signups and activation, reading depth, and the latest audit's findings on each page. Page decisions and the growth report read this file instead of querying again. Numbers only, no judgments; a failed read stays empty, never zero.

prerequisites.reason: The audit names the site's host and pins its findings to the pages they affect.

signup_event.title: Signup event
signup_event.description: The PostHog event a new account sends, such as signed_up. Leave empty to skip signups.

activation_event.title: Activation event
activation_event.description: The PostHog event that means a new account got value. Leave empty to skip activation.

activation_window_days.title: Days after signup that count as activation

website_hosts.title: Website hosts
website_hosts.description: Leave empty to use the audited host, or the top host in Search Console.

brand_terms.title: Brand terms (regular expressions)
brand_terms.description: Searches that name the product. Leave empty to derive them from the host.

internal_flag_property.title: Internal-user flag property
internal_flag_property.description: A PostHog property that is true for team members; person properties start with person:.

always_include.title: Paths to always list in detail, such as /pricing

impressions_reliable_from.title: Impressions reliable from (YYYY-MM-DD)
impressions_reliable_from.description: Only when the Search Console property changed: earlier impressions are left out of weekly and monthly rows.

audit_run_id.title: Organic audit run
audit_run_id.description: Leave empty to use the newest audit the snapshot has not seen yet.
